The '''Hornet''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model produced by [[Minas]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Minas Hornet was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[October 20]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Underworld Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.
